Quarterly report fixture.

Section 1 — Overview
The CIFS connector mounts shares via mount.cifs, walks them with DFS, and
optionally queries ACLs over user-space SMB.

Section 2 — Metrics
Filed under cifs_scanner_* once the metrics refactor lands.
